artboards.title: E · One Thing At A Time

annotations.text:
The reframe behind all six.

Every direction so far has led with a building — and the building keeps being the problem. But the charity's own thesis is "a bunga is not a place, it is what happens inside it." The site has been arguing against itself.

A and D keep Amritsar but stop rendering it. B, C, E and F lead with the teaching instead.

Pick one, or pick two to combine — B's timetable slots under any of the others as the second screen.

My lean: A for the homepage, B immediately below it. A keeps the story and kills the 3D problem; B does the actual job of getting someone into a class.
